marketing_description: The Philips LED Filament Series 571497 delivers 150 W equivalent brightness in a clear-glass A19 (Type A) design with a medium E26 base, operating at 120 V and a warm-white 2700 K color temperature. It provides a CRI of 90, a 300° beam angle and an average life of 15,000 hr, while consuming low power, emitting reduced heat and offering instant on, no-flicker illumination. Its durable construction and easy installation make it suitable for commercial lighting applications.
